channel.desc: Join us on 3ABN Today for a dynamic conversation with Andrew Saunders, Director of the International Rescue and Relief (IRR) Program at Union Adventist University. Born from the dream of a career of adventure, a lifetime of service, IRR has grown from closed doors to global impact, training faith-driven first responders who bring God's love and healing to disaster zones, underserved communities, and international crises.
